name: Shobach
overview: Shobach was a male military leader known for his role as the commander of the army of Hadadezer. The Bible identifies him specifically in this capacity, highlighting his importance in the military hierarchy during the time of King David. No tribal affiliation or additional personal details are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The individual is referred to by two similar proper names in Scripture: Shobach and Shophach. Neither name has a recorded meaning or divine origin, and both appear in distinct biblical passages, indicating the same person. The names do not carry additional significance beyond their identification of this military commander.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Shobach beyond his role as commander of Hadadezer's army. There are no known relatives or personal connections detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shobach's significance lies in his military leadership under Hadadezer, a figure involved in conflicts during King David's reign. His role as commander places him in the context of the geopolitical struggles recorded in the Old Testament, illustrating the opposition David faced. While details about him are scarce, his mention underscores the organized resistance against Israel at that time.
